title: N-glycosylated LTbetaR increases the Th17/Treg cell ratio in liver cancer by blocking RORC ubiquitination and FOXP3 transcription.
authors: Pan, Banglun; Yao, Yuxin; Wu, Hao; Ye, Dongjie; Zhang, Zhu; Zhang, Xinyu; Wang, Xiaoqian; Tang, Nanhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LTbetaR糖基化调控Th17/Treg分化及肝癌进展，涉及FOXP3转录但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: LTbetaR-overexpressing CAR-T cells have demonstrated surprising effectiveness against solid tumors, exhibiting strong anti-exhaustion and proliferation capabilities. However, the role of LTbetaR in CD4(+) T cell differentiation and anti-tumor activity remains unclear. In this study, we employed primary or subcutaneous mouse hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) models and flow cytometry to study the impact of conditional knock-in of Ltbr on CD4(+) T cell differentiation and response, particularly the Th17/Treg cell ratio, and its influence on HCC progression. Immunoprecipitation, immunoblotting, RT-qPCR, molecular docking, and Chromatin Immunoprecipitation-qPCR were performed to investigate the molecular mechanism of CD4(+) T cell differentiation. Adeno-associated virus-modified T cells were introduced into patient-derived orthotopic xenograft (PDOX) model to assess the combined impact of LTbetaR and glycolysis inhibitors on the Th17/Treg cell differentiation. We found that LTbetaR reduced PELI1 expression, preventing TRAF3 protein degradation in Th17 cells. TRAF3 then competed with RORC for SMURF1 binding, enhancing RORC stability and Th17 cell differentiation. LTbetaR also blocked PRDM1 expression, delaying Foxp3 transcription and Treg cell infiltration. Additionally, N-glycosylation supported the stability of LTbetaR by protecting it from ubiquitination. From a therapeutic perspective, glycolysis inhibitors helped LTbetaR balance the proportion of Th17/Treg cells in PDOX model to inhibit tumor growth. In conclusion, our findings indicated that LTbetaR N-glycosylation prevented RORC ubiquitination and Foxp3 transcription, raising the Th17/Treg cell ratio and hindering HCC progression.
abstract_zh: 过表达LTbetaR的CAR-T细胞在实体瘤中展现出显著疗效，表现出强大的抗耗竭和增殖能力。然而，LTbetaR在CD4(+) T细胞分化和抗肿瘤活性中的作用仍不清楚。本研究采用原发或皮下小鼠肝细胞癌（HCC）模型及流式细胞术，研究Ltbr条件性敲入对CD4(+) T细胞分化和反应的影响，特别是Th17/Treg细胞比例及其对HCC进展的作用。通过免疫沉淀、免疫印迹、RT-qPCR、分子对接和染色质免疫沉淀-qPCR探讨CD4(+) T细胞分化的分子机制。将腺相关病毒修饰的T细胞引入患者来源的原位异种移植（PDOX）模型，评估LTbetaR和糖酵解抑制剂对Th17/Treg细胞分化的联合影响。我们发现LTbetaR降低PELI1表达，阻止Th17细胞中TRAF3蛋白降解。随后，TRAF3与RORC竞争结合SMURF1，增强RORC稳定性并促进Th17细胞分化。LTbetaR还阻断PRDM1表达，延迟Foxp3转录和Treg细胞浸润。此外，N-糖基化通过保护LTbetaR免受泛素化来维持其稳定性。从治疗角度看，糖酵解抑制剂帮助LTbetaR在PDOX模型中平衡Th17/Treg细胞比例以抑制肿瘤生长。总之，我们的研究结果表明，LTbetaR的N-糖基化阻止RORC泛素化和Foxp3转录，提高Th17/Treg细胞比例并阻碍HCC进展。
